(A) Agricultural CTRM. ComTech Advisory is the one analyst that states its method. It sizes the market bottom-up from vendor revenue, using vendor data, published financials, headcount and announced deals, with a strict CTRM scope that excludes ERP modules, logistics-only tools and treasury (Issuu preview of the 2024 report, opened). Its 2026 report gives about $2.14B for the global CTRM market. The agricultural and softs share is about 15% in ComTech's agri report snippet and about 24% in a secondary aggregator snippet. That gives roughly $320-510M.
